english_telang: The seat which the sāṅkhyas obtain is reached by the yogas also. He sees (truly), who sees the sāṅkhya and yoga as one.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ
yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati
english_telang: Renunciation, O you of mighty arms! is difficult to reach without devotion the sage possessed of devotion attains Brahman without delay.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते ॥
iast:
yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate
english_telang: He who is possessed of devotion whose self is pure who has restrained his self and who has controlled his senses and who identifies his self with every being is not tainted though he performs (actions). The man of devotion who knows the truth thinks he does nothing at all when he sees hears

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।
पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् ॥
iast:
naiva kiñcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit
paśyañśruṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnangacchansvapañśvasan
english_telang: touches smells eats move-b sleeps breathes

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ॥
iast:
pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
english_telang: talks throws out takes opens or closes the eyelids he holds that the senses deal with the objects of the senses.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
iast:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā
english_telang: He who, casting off (all) attachment, performs actions dedicating them to Brahman, is not tainted by sin, as the lotus-leaf (is not tainted) by water.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ॥
iast:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye
english_telang: Devotees, casting off attachment, perform actions for attaining purity of self, with the body, the mind, the understanding, or even the senses—(all) free (from egoistic notions).

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
iast:
yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm
ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
english_telang: He who is possessed of devotion, abandoning the fruit of actions, attains the highest tranquillity. He who is without devotion, and attached to the fruit (of action), is tied down by (reason of his) acting in consequence of (some) desire.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ॥
iast:
sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
english_telang: The self-restrained, embodied (self) lies at case within the city of nine portals, renouncing all actions by the mind, not doing nor causing (any thing) to be done.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते ॥
iast:
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ
na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate
english_telang: The Lord is not the cause of actions or of the capacity of performing actions amongst men or of the connexion of action and fruit. But nature only works.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥
iast:
nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
english_telang: The Lord receives no one's sin, nor merit either. Knowledge is enveloped by ignorance

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
iast:
jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ
teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam
english_telang: hence all creatures are deluded. But to those who have destroyed that ignorance by knowledge of the self, (such) knowledge like the sun

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः ॥
iast:
tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ
gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
english_telang: shows forth that supreme (principle). And those whose mind is (centred) on it whose (very) self it is who are thoroughly devoted to it and whose final goal it is go never to return having their sins destroyed by knowledge.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
iast:
vidyāvinayasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
english_telang: The wise look upon a Brāhmaṇa possessed of learning and humility, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and a Śvapāka, as alike.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ॥
iast:
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
english_telang: Even here, those have conquered the material world, whose mind rests in equability since Brahman is free from defects and equable, therefore they rest in Brahman. He who knows Brahman whose mind is steady who is not deluded

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः ॥
iast:
na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam
sthirabuddhirasammūḍho brahmavid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
english_telang: and who rests in Brahman

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते ॥
iast:
bāhyasparśeṣvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yatsukham
sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukhamakṣayamaśnute
english_telang: does not exult on finding anything agreeable nor does he grieve on finding anything disagreeable. One whose self is not attached to external objects, obtains the happiness that is in (one's) self and by means of concentration of mind joining one's self (with the Brahman)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥
iast:
ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
english_telang: one obtains indestructible happiness. For the enjoyments born of contact (between senses and their objects) are indeed sources of misery they have a beginning as well as an end. O son of Kuntī ! a wise man feels no pleasure in them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्।
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ॥
iast:
śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
english_telang: He who even in this world before his release from the body is able to bear the agitations produced from desire and wrath is a devoted man he is a happy man.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः।
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
yo.antaḥsukho.antarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ
sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto.adhigacchati
english_telang: The devotee whose happiness is within (himself) whose recreation is within (himself) and whose light (of knowledge) also is within (himself) becoming (one with) the Brahman

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
iast:
labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ
chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
english_telang: obtain the Brahmic bliss. The sages whose sins have perished whose misgivings are destroyed who are self-restrained and who are intent on the welfare of all beings

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् ॥
iast:
kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām
abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām
english_telang: obtain the Brahmic bliss. To the ascetics who are free from desire and wrath and whose minds are restrained and who have knowledge of the self

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ॥
iast:
sparśānkṛtvā bahirbāhyāṃścakṣuścaivāntare bhruvoḥ
prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau
english_telang: the Brahmic bliss is on both sides (of death). The sage who excludes (from his mind) external objects, (concentrates) the visual power between the brows and making the upward and downward life-breaths even confines their movements within the nose

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ॥
iast:
yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
english_telang: who restrains senses mind and understanding whose highest goal is final emancipation from whom desire fear

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
iast:
bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram
suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati
english_telang: and wrath have departed is indeed for ever released (from birth and death). He knowing me to be the enjoyer of all sacrifices and penances, the great Lord of all worlds, and the friend of all beings, attains tranquillity.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ
english_telang: He who, regardless of the fruit of actions, performs the actions which ought to be performed, is the devotee and renouncer not he who discards the (sacred) fires, nor he who performs no acts.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ॥
iast:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava
na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana
english_telang: Know, O son of Pāṇḍu! that what is called renunciation is devotion for nobody becomes a devotee who has not renounced (all) fancies. To the sage who wishes to rise to devotion

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ॥
iast:
ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate
english_telang: action is said to be a means and to him when he has risen to devotion tranquillity is said to be a means. When one does not attach oneself to objects of sense

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ॥
iast:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate
sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate
english_telang: nor to action renouncing all fancies then is one said to have risen to devotion.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
iast:
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ
english_telang: (A man) should elevate his self by his self he should not debase his self for even (a man's) own self is his friend, (a man's) own self is also his enemy. To him who has subjugated his self by his self

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
iast:
bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat
english_telang: his self is a friend but to him who has not restrained his self, his own self behaves inimically, like an enemy. The self of one who has subjugated his self and is tranquil is absolutely concentrated (on itself)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ॥
iast:
jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
english_telang: in the midst of cold and heat pleasure and pain as well as honour and dishonour.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥
iast:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
english_telang: The devotee whose self is contented with knowledge and experience who is unmoved who has restrained his senses and to whom a sod a stone and gold are alike is said to be devoted. And he is esteemed highest who thinks alike about well-wishers

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
iast:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu
sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate
english_telang: friends and enemies and those who are indifferent

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
iast:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ
english_telang: and those who take part with both sides and those who are objects of hatred and relatives as well as about the good and the sinful. A devotee should constantly devote his self to abstraction, remaining in a secret place, alone, with his mind and self restrained, without expectations, and without belongings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
iast:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram
english_telang: Fixing his seat firmly in a clean place not too high nor too low and covered over with a sheet of cloth a deerskin and (blades of) Kuśa (grass),—and there seated on (that) seat

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
iast:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye
english_telang: fixing his mind exclusively on one point with the workings of the mind and senses restrained he should practice devotion for purity of self.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
iast:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan
english_telang: Holding his body head

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
iast:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
english_telang: and neck even and unmoved, (remaining) steady looking at the tip of his own nose and not looking about in (all) directions with a tranquil self devoid of fear and adhering to the rules of Brahmacārins he should restrain his mind and (concentrate it) on me and sit down engaged in devotion regarding me as his final goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati
english_telang: Thus constantly devoting his self to abstraction, a devotee whose mind is restrained, attains that tranquillity which culminates in final emancipation, and assimilation with me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
iast:
nātyaśnatastu yogo.asti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ
na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna
english_telang: Devotion is not his, O Arjuna ! who eats too much, nor his who cats not at all not his who is addicted to too much sleep nor his who is (ever) awake. That devotion which destroys (all) misery is his

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
iast:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā
english_telang: who takes due food and exercise who toils duly in all works and who sleeps and awakes (in) due (time). When (a man's) mind well restrained becomes steady upon the self alone

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
iast:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā
english_telang: then he being indifferent to all objects of desire

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
iast:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ
english_telang: is said to be devoted. As a light standing in a windless (place) flickers not that is declared to be the parallel for a devotee whose mind is restrained and who devotes his self to abstraction. That (mental condition)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
iast:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati
english_telang: in which the mind restrained by practice of abstraction ceases to work in which too, one seeing the self by the self, is pleased in the self

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
english_telang: in which one experiences that infinite happiness which transcends the senses, and which can be grasped by the understanding only and adhering to which, one never swerves from the truth

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
iast:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate
english_telang: acquiring which, one thinks no other acquisition higher than it and adhering to which, one is not shaken off even by great misery

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
iast:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo.anirviṇṇacetasā
english_telang: that should be understood to be called devotion in which there is a severance of all connexion with pain. That devotion should be practised with steadiness and with an undesponding heart. Abandoning without exception all desires which are produced from fancies

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
iast:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ
english_telang: and restraining the whole group of the senses on all sides by the mind only

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
iast:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet
english_telang: one should by slow steps become quiescent with a firm resolve coupled with courage and fixing his mind upon the self, should think of nothing.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
iast:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet
english_telang: Wherever the active and unsteady mind breaks forth, there one should ever restrain it, and fix it steadily on the self alone. The highest happiness comes to such a devotee whose mind is fully tranquil in whom the quality of passion has been suppressed

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
iast:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam
english_telang: who is free from sin and who is become (one with) the Brahman .

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute
english_telang: Thus constantly devoting his self to abstraction, a devotee, freed from sin, easily obtains that supreme happiness—contact with the Brahman. He who has devoted his self to abstraction by devotion looking alike on everything

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
english_telang: sees the self abiding in all beings and all beings in the self. To him who sees me in everything

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
iast:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
english_telang: and everything in me I am never lost and he is not lost to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno.api sa yogī mayi vartate
english_telang: The devotee who worships me abiding in all beings holding that all is one lives in me however he may be living. That devotee

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
iast:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo.arjuna
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
english_telang: O Arjuna! is deemed to be the best who looks alike on pleasure or pain

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
yo.ayaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām
english_telang: whatever it may be in all (creatures) comparing. all with his own (pleasure or pain). I cannot see, O destroyer of Madhu! (how) the sustained existence (is to be secured) of this devotion by means of equanimity which you have declared-in consequence of fickleness. For O Kṛṣṇa ! the mind is fickle

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम्।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥
iast:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram
english_telang: boisterous strong and obstinate and I think that to restrain it is as difficult as (to restrain) the wind.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
english_telang: Doubtless, O you of mighty arms! the mind is difficult to restrain, and fickle. Still, O son of Kuntī ! it may be restrained by constant practice and by indifference (to worldly objects). It is my belief

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
iast:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo.avāptumupāyataḥ
english_telang: that devotion is hard to obtain for one who does not restrain his self. But by one who is self-restrained and assiduous it can be obtained through (proper) expedients.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
english_telang: What is the end of him O Kṛṣṇa! who does not attain the consummation of his devotion being not assiduous and having a mind shaken off from devotion, (though) full of faith? Does he fallen from both (paths)

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
iast:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
english_telang: go to ruin like a broken cloud being

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
iast:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate
english_telang: O you of mighty arms! without support and deluded on the path (leading) to the Brahman? Be pleased, O Kṛṣṇa! to entirely destroy this doubt of mine, for none else than you can destroy this doubt.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati
english_telang: O son of Pṛthā! neither in this world nor the next, is ruin for him for, O dear friend! none who performs good (deeds) comes to an evil end.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
iast:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo.abhijāyate
english_telang: He who is fallen from devotion attains the worlds of those who perform meritorious acts dwells (there) for many a year

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
iast:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam
english_telang: and is afterwards born into a family of holy and illustrious men. Or he is even born into a family of talented devotees for such a birth as that in this world is more difficult to obtain.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
iast:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
english_telang: There he comes into contact with the knowledge which belonged to him in his former body

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
iast:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo.api saḥ
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate
english_telang: and then again O descendant of Kuru ! he works for perfection. For even though reluctant he is led away by the self-same former practice and although he only wishes to learn devotion he rises above the (fruits of action laid down in the) divine word. But the devotee working with great efforts

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim
english_telang: and cleared of his sins attains perfection after many births and then reaches the supreme goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
iast:
tapasvibhyo.adhiko yogī jñānibhyo.api mato.adhikaḥ
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna
english_telang: The devotee is esteemed higher than the performers of penances, higher even than the men of knowledge, and the devotee is higher than the men of action therefore

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
iast:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
english_telang: O Arjuna! become a devotee. And even among all devotees he who being full of faith worships me with his inmost self intent on me is esteemed by me to be the most devoted.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
english_telang: O son of Pṛthā! now hear how you can without doubt know me fully, fixing your mind on me, and resting in me, and practising devotion. I will now tell you exhaustively about knowledge together with experience

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
iast:
jñānaṃ te.ahaṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo.anyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate
english_telang: that being known, there is nothing further left in this world to know.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ
english_telang: Among thousands of men, only some work for perfection and even of those who have reached perfection, and who are assiduous, only some know me truly.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥
iast:
bhūmirāpo.analo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca
ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā
english_telang: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, understanding, and egoism, thus is my nature divided eightfold. But this is a lower (form of my) nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
iast:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
english_telang: Know (that there is) another (form of my) nature, and higher than this, which is animate, O you of mighty arms! and by which this universe is upheld.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
iast:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā
english_telang: Know that all things have these (for their) source. I am the producer and the destroyer of the whole universe.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
iast:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
english_telang: There is nothing else, O Dhanañjaya ! higher than myself all this is woven upon me, like numbers of pearls upon a thread.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
iast:
raso.ahamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
english_telang: I am the taste in water, O son of Kuntī ! I am the light of the sun and moon. I am 'Om' in all the Vedas , sound in space, and manliness in human beings

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
iast:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu
english_telang: I am the fragrant smell in the earth, refulgence in the fire I am life in all beings, and penance in those who perform penance.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
iast:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
english_telang: Know me, O son of Pṛthā! to be the eternal seed of all beings I am the discernment of the discerning ones, and I the glory of the glorious.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo.asmi bharatarṣabha
english_telang: I am also the strength, unaccompanied by fondness or desire, of the strong. And, O chief of the descendants of Bharata! I am love unopposed to piety among all beings. And all entities which are of the quality of goodness and those which are of the quality of passion and of darkness

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
iast:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
english_telang: know that they are indeed

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam
english_telang: all from me I am not in them, but they are in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
iast:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
english_telang: The whole universe deluded by these three states of mind, developed from the qualities, does not know me, who am beyond them and inexhaustible for this delusion of mine, developed from the qualities, is divine and difficult to transcend. Those cross beyond this delusion who resort to me alone.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥
iast:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
english_telang: Wicked men doers of evil (acts) who are deluded who are deprived of their knowledge by (this) delusion

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino.arjuna
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
english_telang: and who incline to the demoniac state of mind do not resort to me. But O Arjuna ! doers of good (acts) of four classes worship me: one who is distressed one who is seeking after knowledge one who wants wealth and one O chief of the descendants of Bharata! who is possessed of knowledge. Of these he who is possessed of knowledge

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
iast:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate
priyo hi jñānino.atyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
english_telang: who is always devoted and whose worship is (addressed) to one (Being) only is esteemed highest. For to the man of knowledge I am dear above all things and he is dear to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
english_telang: All these are noble. But the man possessed of knowledge is deemed by me to be my own self. For he with (his) self devoted to abstraction has taken to me as the goal than which there is nothing higher.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
iast:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
english_telang: At the end of many lives, the man possessed of knowledge approaches me, (believing) that Vāsudeva is everything. Such a high-souled man is very hard to find.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
iast:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante.anyadevatāḥ
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
english_telang: Those who are deprived of knowledge by various desires approach other divinities, observing various regulations, and controlled by their own natures.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham
english_telang: Whichever form (of deity) any worshipper wishes to worship with faith, to that form I render his faith steady.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
iast:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaivavihitānhi tān
english_telang: Possessed Of that faith he seeks to propitiate (the deity in) that (form)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
iast:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi
english_telang: and obtains from it those beneficial things which he desires, (though they are) really given by me. But the fruit thus (obtained) by them who have little judgment is perishable. Those who worship the divinities go to the divinities, and my worshippers, too, go to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
iast:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam
english_telang: The undiscerning ones, not knowing my transcendent and inexhaustible essence, than which there is nothing higher, think me, who am unperceived, to have become perceptible.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ
mūḍho.ayaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam
english_telang: Surrounded by the delusion of my mystic power, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world knows not me unborn and inexhaustible.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
iast:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
english_telang: I know, O Arjuna! the things which have been, those which are, and those which are to be. But me nobody knows.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥
iast:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata
sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa
english_telang: All beings

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
iast:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
english_telang: O terror of (your) foes! are deluded at the time of birth by the delusion O descendant of Bharata! caused by the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion. But the men of meritorious actions whose sins have terminated worship me being released from the delusion (caused) by the pairs of opposites and being firm in their beliefs. Those who resting on me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
iast:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
english_telang: work for release from old age and death know the Brahman the whole Adhyātma

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
iast:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ
prayāṇakāle.api ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ
english_telang: and all action. And those who know me with the Adhibhūta the Adhidaiva and the Adhiyajña having minds devoted to abstraction know me at the time of departure (from this world).

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate
english_telang: What is that Brahman what the Adhyātma and what O best of beings! is action? And what is called the Adhibhūta? And who is the Adhiyajña

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
iast:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko.atra dehe.asminmadhusūdana
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo.asi niyatātmabhiḥ
english_telang: and how in this body O destroyer of Madhu? And how too are you to be known at the time of departure (from this world) by those who restrain their selfs?

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo.adhyātmamucyate
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ
english_telang: The Brahman is the supreme, the indestructible. Its manifestation (as an individual self) is called the Adhyātma. The offering (of an oblation to any divinity), which is the cause of the production and development of all things, is named action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
iast:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam
adhiyajño.ahamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara
english_telang: The Adhibhūta is all perishable things. The Adhidaivata is the (primal) being. And the Adhiyajña O best of embodied (beings)! is I myself in this body. And he who leaves this body and departs (from this world) remembering me in (his) last moments comes into my essence.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
iast:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
english_telang: There is no doubt of that.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
iast:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
english_telang: Also whichever form (of deity) he remembers when he finally leaves this body to that he goes O son of Kuntī ! having been used to ponder on it.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः (orसंशयम्) ॥
iast:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ
english_telang: Therefore, at all times remember me, and engage in battle. Fixing your mind and understanding on me, you will come to me, there is no doubt.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
iast:
orsaṃśayama abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan
english_telang: He who thinks of the supreme divine Being O son of Pṛthā! with a mind not (running) to other (objects) and possessed of abstraction in the shape of continuous meditation (about the supreme) goes to him. He who possessed of reverence (for the supreme Being) with a steady mind and with the power of devotion

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
iast:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāraṃ aṇoraṇīyaṃsamanusmaredyaḥ
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpaṃ ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
english_telang: properly concentrates the life-breath between the brows and meditates on the ancient Seer the ruler more minute than the minutest atom the supporter of all who is of an unthinkable form whose brilliance is like that of the sun and who is beyond all darkness

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
iast:
prayāṇakāle manasā.acalena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
english_telang: he attains to that transcendent and divine Being.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
iast:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
english_telang: I will tell you briefly about the seat, which those who know the Vedas declare to be indestructible which entered by ascetics from whom all desires have departed and wishing for which, people pursue the mode of life of Brahmacārins . He who leaves the body and departs (from this world) stopping up all passages

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।
मूध्न्यार्धायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥
iast:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca
mūdhnyā^^rdhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām
english_telang: and confining the mind within the heart placing the life-breath in the head

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
english_telang: and adhering to uninterrupted meditation repeating the single syllable 'Om,' (signifying) the eternal Brahman

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
iast:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
english_telang: and meditating on me he reaches the highest goal. To the devotee who constantly practises abstraction O son of Pṛthā! and who with a mind not (turned) to anything else is ever and constantly meditating on me I am easy of access.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
iast:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
english_telang: The high-souled ones, who achieve the highest perfection, attaining to me, do not again come to life, which is transient, a home of woes.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
iast:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino.arjuna
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
english_telang: All worlds O Arjuna ! up to the world of Brahman are (destined) to return. But O son of Kuntī! after attaining to me there is no birth again.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥
iast:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyad brahmaṇo viduḥ
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te.ahorātravido janāḥ
english_telang: Those who know a day of Brahman to end after one thousand ages and the night to terminate after one thousand ages are the persons who know day and night. On the advent of day

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥
iast:
avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake
english_telang: all perceptible things are produced from the unperceived and on the advent of night they dissolve in that same (principle) called the unperceived.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥
iast:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
rātryāgame.avaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame
english_telang: This same assemblage of entities being produced again and again dissolves on the advent of night and O son of Pṛthā! issues forth on the advent of day

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
iast:
parastasmāttu bhāvo.anyo.avyakto.avyaktātsanātanaḥ
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
english_telang: without a will of its own. But there is another entity unperceived and eternal and distinct from this unperceived (principle) which is not destroyed when all entities are destroyed. It is called the unperceived, the indestructible

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
iast:
avyakto.akṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
english_telang: they call it the highest goal. Attaining to it none returns. That is my supreme abode. That supreme Being

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
iast:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
english_telang: O son of Pṛthā! he in whom all these entities dwell and by whom all this is permeated

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
english_telang: is to be attained to by reverence not (directed) to another. I will state the times, O descendant of Bharata! at which devotees departing (from this world) go, never to return, or to return.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अग्निर्जोतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
iast:
agnirjotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
english_telang: The fire the flame the day the bright fortnight the six months of the northern solstice

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥
iast:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate
english_telang: departing (from the world) in these those who know the Brahman go to the Brahman. Smoke, night, the dark fortnight, the six months of the southern solstice, (dying) in these, the devotee goes to the lunar light and returns.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ॥
iast:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ
english_telang: These two paths, bright and dark, are deemed to be eternal in this world. By the one, (a man) goes never to return, by the other he comes back.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥
iast:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna
english_telang: Knowing these two paths, O son of Pṛthā! no devotee is deluded. Therefore at all times be possessed of devotion O Arjuna! A devotee knowing all this obtains all the holy fruit which is prescribed for (study of) the Vedas

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
iast:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
english_telang: for sacrifices and also for penances and gifts and he attains to the highest and primeval seat.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase.aśubhāt
english_telang: Now I will speak to you who are not given to carping of that most mysterious knowledge accompanied by experience by knowing which you will be released from evil.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam
english_telang: It is the chief among the sciences, the chief among the mysteries. It is the best means of sanctification. It is imperishable, not opposed to the sacred law. It is to be apprehended directly, and is easy to practise.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
iast:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
english_telang: O terror of your foes! those men who have no faith in this holy doctrine, return to the path of this mortal world, without attaining to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥
iast:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ
english_telang: This whole universe is pervaded by me in an unperceived form. All entities live in me, but I do not live in them. Nor yet do all entities live in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
iast:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
english_telang: See my divine power. Supporting all entities and producing all entities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥
iast:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya
english_telang: my self lives not in (those) entities. As the great and ubiquitous atmosphere always remains in space know that similarly all entities live in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham
english_telang: At the expiration of a Kalpa , O son of Kuntī ! all entities enter my nature and at the beginning of a Kalpa, I again bring them forth.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
iast:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt
english_telang: Taking the control of my own nature I bring forth again and again this whole collection of entities without a will of its own by the power of nature. But

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
iast:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu
english_telang: O Arjuna ! these actions do not fetter me who remain like one unconcerned and who am unattached to those actions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
iast:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
english_telang: Nature gives birth to movables and immovables through me, the supervisor, and by reason of that, O son of Kuntī! the universe revolves. Deluded people of vain hopes

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
iast:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram
english_telang: vain acts

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
iast:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ
english_telang: vain knowledge

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam
english_telang: whose minds are disordered and who are inclined to the delusive nature of Asuras and Rākṣasas not knowing my highest nature as great lord of all entities disregard me as I have assumed a human body. But the high-souled ones O son of Pṛthā! who are inclined to the godlike nature knowing me as the inexhaustible source of (all) entities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
iast:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate
english_telang: worship me with minds not (turned) elsewhere. Constantly glorifying me, and exerting themselves, firm in their vows, and saluting me with reverence,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
iast:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham
english_telang: they worship me, being always devoted. And others again, offering up the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me as one, as distinct, and as all-pervading in numerous forms.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम्।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
iast:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham
mantro.ahamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam
english_telang: I am the Kratu, I am the Yajña, I am the Svadhā, I the product of the herbs. I am the sacred verse. I too am the sacrificial butter, and I the fire, I the offering. I am the father of this universe

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥
iast:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca
english_telang: the mother the creator the grandsire the thing to be known the means of sanctification the syllable Om the Ṛk Sāman and Yajus also

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam
english_telang: the goal the sustainer the lord the supervisor the residence the asylum the friend the source and that in which it merges the support the receptacle and the inexhaustible seed.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥
iast:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna
english_telang: I cause heat and I send forth and stop showers. I am immortality and also death and I, O Arjuna! am that which is and that which is not.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
iast:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante
te puṇyamāsādya surendralokaṃ aśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān
english_telang: Those who know the three (branches of) knowledge who drink the Soma juice whose sins are washed away offer sacrifices and pray to me for a passage into heaven and reaching the holy world of the lord of gods they enjoy in the celestial regions the celestial pleasures of the gods. And having enjoyed that great heavenly world

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
iast:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
english_telang: they enter the mortal world when (their) merit is exhausted. Thus those who wish for objects of desire and resort to the ordinances of the three ( Vedas )

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
english_telang: obtain (as the fruit) going and coming. To those men who worship me meditating on me and on no one else and who are constantly devoted I give new gifts and preserve what is acquired by them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
iast:
ye.apyanyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ
te.api māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam
english_telang: Even those O son of Kuntī! who being devotees of other divinities worship with faith

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥
iast:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te
english_telang: worship me only, (but) irregularly. For I am the enjoyer as well as the lord of all sacrifices. But they know me not truly therefore do they fall.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥
iast:
yānti devavratā devānpitṝnyānti pitṛvratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino.api mām
english_telang: Those who make vows to the gods go to the gods those who make vows to the manes go to the manes, those who worship the Bhūtas go to the Bhūtas and those likewise who worship me go to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
iast:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
english_telang: Whoever with devotion offers me leaf, flower, fruit, water, that, presented with devotion, I accept from him whose self is pure.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
iast:
yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam
english_telang: Whatever you do, O son of Kuntī! whatever you eat, whatever sacrifice you make, whatever you give, whatever penance you perform, do that as offered to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥
iast:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi
english_telang: Thus will you be released from the bonds of action the fruits of which are agreeable or disagreeable. And with your self possessed of (this) devotion, (this) renunciation you will be released (from the bonds of action) and will come to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
iast:
samo.ahaṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo.asti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
english_telang: I am alike to all beings to me none is hateful, none dear. But those who worship me with devotion (dwell) in me, and I too in them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
iast:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
english_telang: Even if a very ill-conducted man worships me, not worshipping any one else, he must certainly be deemed to be good, for he has well resolved.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
iast:
kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
english_telang: He soon becomes devout of heart, and obtains lasting tranquillity. (You may) affirm, O son of Kuntī! that my devotee is never ruined. For, O son of Pṛthā! even those who are of sinful birth, women, Vaiśyas

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye.api syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste.api yānti parāṃ gatim
english_telang: and Śūdras likewise, resorting to me, attain the supreme goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥
iast:
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā
anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
english_telang: What then (need be said of) holy Brāhmaṇas and royal saints who are (my) devotees? Coming to this transient unhappy world, worship me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥
iast:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
english_telang: (Place your) mind on me, become my devotee, my worshipper reverence me, and thus making me your highest goal, and devoting your self to abstraction, you will certainly come to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
yatte.ahaṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
english_telang: Yet again O you of mighty arms! listen to my excellent words which out of a wish for your welfare I speak to you who are delighted (with them).

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥
iast:
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
english_telang: Not the multitudes of gods, nor the great sages know my source for I am in every way the origin of the gods and great sages. Of (all) mortals he who knows me to be unborn without beginning

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
iast:
yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
english_telang: the great lord of the world being free from delusion is released from all sins. Intelligence knowledge freedom from delusion

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥
iast:
buddhirjñānamasammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo.abhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
english_telang: forgiveness truth restraint of the senses tranquillity pleasure pain

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
iast:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo.ayaśaḥ
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
english_telang: birth death fear and also security harmlessness equability

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
iast:
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
english_telang: contentment penance, (making) gifts glory disgrace all these different tempers of living beings are from me alone. The seven great sages and likewise the four ancient Manus whose descendants are (all) these people in the world were all born from my mind, (partaking) of my powers.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
iast:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so.avikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
english_telang: Whoever correctly knows these powers and emanations of mine, becomes possessed of devotion free from indecision of this (there is) no doubt.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
iast:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
english_telang: The wise, full of love, worship me, believing that I am the origin of all, and that all moves on through me. (Placing their) minds on me offering (their) lives to me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
iast:
maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
english_telang: instructing each other and speaking about me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
iast:
teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
english_telang: they are always contented and happy. To these who are constantly devoted and who worship with love, I give that knowledge by which they attain to me. And remaining in their hearts

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥
iast:
teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ
nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
english_telang: I destroy with the brilliant lamp of knowledge the darkness born of ignorance in such (men) only out of compassion for them.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān
puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum
english_telang: You are the supreme Brahman , the supreme goal, the holiest of the holy.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
iast:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
english_telang: All sages as well as the divine sage Nārada Asita Devala and Vyāsa call you the eternal being divine the first god the unborn the all-pervading. And so too

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
iast:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
english_telang: you tell me yourself O Kesava! I believe all this that you tell me (to be) true for, O lord! neither the gods nor demons understand your manifestation.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
iast:
svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama
bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
english_telang: You only know your self by your self. O best of beings! creator of all things! lord of all things! god of gods! lord of the universe! be pleased to declare without

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥
iast:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
english_telang: exception your divine emanations by which emanations you stand pervading all these worlds.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
iast:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo.asi bhagavanmayā
english_telang: How shall I know you, O you of mystic power! always meditating on you? And in what various entities, O lord! should I meditate on you?

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
iast:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me.amṛtam
english_telang: Again, O Ganārdana! do you yourself declare your powers and emanations because hearing this nectar, I (still) feel no satiety.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
english_telang: Well then, O best of Kauravas! I will state to you my own divine emanations but (only) the chief (ones), for there is no end to the extent of my (emanations).

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
iast:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
english_telang: I am the self, O Guḍākesa! seated in the hearts of all beings. I am the beginning and the middle and the end also of all beings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
iast:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān
marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī
english_telang: I am Viṣṇu among the Ādityas , the beaming sun among the shining (bodies) I am Marīci among the Maruts , and the moon among the lunar mansions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥
iast:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo.asmi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā
english_telang: Among the Vedas , I am the Sāma - veda . I am Indra among the gods. And I am mind among the senses.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
iast:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām
vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham
english_telang: I am consciousness in (living) beings. And I am Śaṅkara among the Rudras the lord of wealth among Yakṣas and Rakṣases. And I am fire among the Vasus and Meru among the high-topped (mountains). And know me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
iast:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ
english_telang: O Arjuna ! to be Bṛhaspati the chief among domestic priests. I am Skanda among generals. I am the ocean among reservoirs of water.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
iast:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram
yajñānāṃ japayajño.asmi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
english_telang: I am Bhṛgu among the great sages. I am the single syllable (Om) among words. Among sacrifices I am the Japa sacrifice the Himālaya among the firmly-fixed (mountains)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
iast:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
english_telang: the Aśvattha among all trees, and Nārada among divine sages Citraratha among the heavenly choristers, the sage Kapila among the Siddhas .

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥
iast:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
english_telang: Among horses know me to be Uccaiśśravas, brought forth by (the labours for) the nectar and Airāvata among the great elephants, and the ruler. of men among men.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
iast:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk
prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ
english_telang: I am the thunderbolt among weapons, the wish-giving (cow) among cows. And I am love which generates. Among serpents I am Vāsuki.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
iast:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham
english_telang: Among Nāga snakes I am Ananta I am Varuṇa among aquatic beings. And I am Aryaman among the manes, and Yama among rulers. Among demons, too, I am Pralhāda.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
iast:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro.ahaṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām
english_telang: I am the king of death ( Kāla , time) among those that count. Among beasts I am the lord of beasts, and the son of Vinatā among birds.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
iast:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī
english_telang: I am the wind among those that blow. I am Rāma among those that wield weapons. Among fishes I am Makara and among streams the Jāhnavī. Of created things I am the beginning and the end and the middle also

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
iast:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham
english_telang: O Arjuna! Among sciences I am the science of the Adhyātma and I am the argument of controversialists.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
iast:
akṣarāṇāmakāro.asmi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
english_telang: Among letters I am the letter A, and among the group of compounds the copulative compound. I myself am time inexhaustible, and I the creator whose faces are in all directions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
iast:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
english_telang: I am death who seizes all, and the source of what is to be. And among females, fame, fortune, speech, memory, intellect, courage. forgiveness.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
iast:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo.ahamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
english_telang: Likewise among Sāman hymns, I am the Bṛhat-sāman, and I the Gāyatrī among metres. I am Mārgaśīrṣa among the months, the spring among the seasons

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
iast:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
jayo.asmi vyavasāyo.asmi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
english_telang: of cheats, I am the game of dice I am the glory of the glorious, I am victory, I am industry, I am the goodness of the good.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
iast:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo.asmi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
english_telang: I am Vāsudeva among the descendants of Vṛṣṇi, and Arjuna among the Pāṇḍavas . Among sages also, I am Vyāsa and among the discerning ones, I am the discerning Uśanas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
english_telang: I am the rod of those that restrain, and the policy of those that desire victory. I am silence respecting secrets.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
iast:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
english_telang: I am the knowledge of those that have knowledge And, O Arjuna! I am also that which is the seed of all things. There is nothing movable or immovable which can exist without me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
iast:
nānto.asti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
english_telang: O terror of your foes! there is no end to my divine emanations.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥
iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃśasambhavam
english_telang: Here I have declared the extent of (those) emanations only in part. Whatever thing (there is) of power or glorious or splendid know all that to be produced from portions of my energy. Or rather

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
iast:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
english_telang: O Arjuna! what have you to do knowing all this at large? I stand supporting all this by (but) a single portion (of myself).

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam
yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho.ayaṃ vigato mama
english_telang: In consequence of the excellent and mysterious words concerning the relation of the supreme and individual soul, which you have spoken for my welfare this delusion of mine is gone away.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥
iast:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā
tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam
english_telang: O you whose eyes are like lotus leaves! I have heard from you at large about the production and dissolution of things, and also about your inexhaustible greatness. O highest lord! what you have said about yourself is so.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥
iast:
evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
