english_telang: I wish, O best of beings! to see your divine form. If

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho
yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānamavyayam
english_telang: O lord! you think that it is possible for me to look upon it then O lord of the possessors of mystic power! show your inexhaustible form to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo.atha sahasraśaḥ
nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
english_telang: In hundreds and in thousands see my forms, O son of Pṛthā! various, divine, and of various colours and shapes.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥
iast:
paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśvinau marutastathā
bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata
english_telang: See the Ādityas , Vasus , Rudras , the two Aśvins , and Maruts likewise. And O descendant of Bharata! see wonders, in numbers, unseen before. Within my body

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ॥
iast:
ihaikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram
mama dehe guḍākeśa yaccānyad draṣṭumicchasi
english_telang: O Guḍākesa! see to-day the whole universe

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥
iast:
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
english_telang: including (everything) movable and immovable, (all) in one and whatever else you wish to see. But you will not be able to see me with merely this eye of yours. I give you an eye divine. (Now) see my divine power.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
सञ्जय उवाच।
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥
iast:
sañjaya uvāca
evamuktvā tato rājanmahāyogeśvaro hariḥ
darśayāmāsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpamaiśvaram
english_telang: Having spoken thus O king! Hari

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥
iast:
anekavaktranayanamanekādbhutadarśanam
anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
english_telang: the great lord of the possessors of mystic power then showed to the son of Pṛthā. his supreme divine form having many mouths and eyes having (within it) many wonderful sights having many celestial ornaments having many celestial weapons held erect

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
iast:
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devamanantaṃ viśvatomukham
english_telang: wearing celestial flowers and vestments having an anointment of celestial perfumes full of every wonder the infinite deity with faces in all directions.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
iast:
divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ
english_telang: If in the heavens, the lustre of a thousand suns burst forth all at once, that would be like the lustre of that mighty one.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥
iast:
tatraikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā
apaśyaddevadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavastadā
english_telang: There the son of Pāṇḍu then observed in the body of the god of gods the whole universe (all) in one, and divided into numerous (divisions).

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ॥
iast:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanañjayaḥ
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
english_telang: Then Dhanañjaya filled with amazement, and with hair standing on end, bowed his head before the god, and spoke with joined hands.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān
brahmāṇamīśaṃ kamalāsanasthaṃ ṛṣīṃśca sarvānuragāṃśca divyān
english_telang: O god! I see within your body the gods, as also all the groups of various beings and the lord Brahman seated on (his) lotus seat, and all the sages and celestial snakes.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ॥
iast:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato.anantarūpam
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
english_telang: I see you, who are of countless forms, possessed of many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes on all sides. And, O lord of the universe! O you of all forms!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्
दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ॥
iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam
paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantād dīptānalārkadyutimaprameyam
english_telang: I do not see your end or middle or beginning. I see you bearing a coronet and a mace and a discus—a mass of glory brilliant on all sides difficult to look at having on all sides the effulgence of a blazing fire or sun and indefinable.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥
iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
english_telang: You are indestructible, the supreme one to be known. You are the highest support of this universe. You are the inexhaustible protector of everlasting piety. I believe you to be the eternal being.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥
iast:
anādimadhyāntamanantavīryam anantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
english_telang: I see you void of beginning middle end—of infinite power of unnumbered arms having the sun and moon for eyes having a mouth like a blazing fire

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥
iast:
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
english_telang: and heating the universe with your radiance. For this space between heaven and earth and all the quarters are pervaded by you alone. Looking at this wonderful and terrible form of yours, O high-souled one! the three worlds are affrighted. For here these groups of gods are entering into you.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥
iast:
amī hi tvāṃ surasaṅghā viśanti kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
english_telang: Some being afraid are praying with joined hands, and the groups of great sages and Siddhas are saying 'Welfare!' and praising you with abundant (hymns) of praise.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥
iast:
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve.aśvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca
gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṅghā vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāścaiva sarve
english_telang: The Rudras and Ādityas the Vasus the Sādhyas the Viśvas the two Aśvins the Maruts and the Ushmapas and the groups of Gandharvas Yakṣas demons and Siddhas are all looking at you amazed. Seeing your mighty form

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥
iast:
rūpaṃ mahatte bahuvaktranetraṃ mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam
bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitāstathāham
english_telang: with many mouths and eyes with many arms thighs and feet with many stomachs and fearful with many jaws all people and I likewise are much alarmed O you of mighty arms!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
iast:
nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamanekavarṇaṃ vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram
dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
english_telang: Seeing you O Viṣṇu ! touching the skies radiant possessed of many hues with a gaping mouth and with large blazing eyes I am much alarmed in my inmost self and feel no courage

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
english_telang: no tranquillity. And seeing your mouths terrible by the jaws and resembling the fire of destruction I cannot recognise the (various) directions I feel no comfort. Be gracious O lord of gods! who pervadest the universe. And all these sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra together with all the bands of kings

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
iast:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathāsau sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ
english_telang: and Bhīṣma and Droṇa and this charioteer's son likewise together with our principal warriors also

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ॥
iast:
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni
kecidvilagnā daśanāntareṣu sandṛśyante cūrṇitairuttamāṅgaiḥ
english_telang: are rapidly entering your mouths fearful and horrific by (reason of your) jaws. And some with their heads smashed are seen (to be) stuck in the spaces between the teeth. As the many rapid currents of a river's waters run towards the sea alone

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ॥
iast:
yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo.ambuvegāḥ samudramevābhimukhā dravanti
tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā viśanti vaktrāṇyabhivijvalanti
english_telang: so do these heroes of the human world enter your mouths blazing all round. As butterflies with increased velocity

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्-
तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥
iast:
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokāsa- tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
english_telang: enter a blazing fire to their destruction

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-
लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥
iast:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl- lokānsamagrānvadanairjvaladbhiḥ
tejobhirāpūrya jagatsamagraṃ bhāsastavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
english_telang: so too do these people enter your mouths with increased velocity (only) to their destruction. Swallowing all these people, you are licking them over and over again from all sides, with your blazing mouths. Your fierce splendours, O Viṣṇu! filling the whole universe with (their) effulgence, are heating it.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥
iast:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo namo.astu te devavara prasīda
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
english_telang: Tell me who you are in this fierce form. Salutations be to thee, O chief of the gods! Be gracious. I wish to know you, the primeval, one, for I do not understand your actions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kālo.asmi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ
ṛte.api tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye.avasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
english_telang: I am death, the destroyer of the worlds, fully developed, and I am now active about the overthrow of the worlds. Even without you, the warriors standing in the adverse hosts, shall all cease to be.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥
iast:
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
english_telang: Therefore, be up, obtain glory, and vanquishing (your) foes, enjoy a prosperous kingdom. All these have been already killed by me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान्।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥
iast:
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca karṇaṃ tathānyānapi yodhavīrān
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi mavyathiṣṭhā yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
english_telang: Be only the instrument, O Savyasācin! Droṇa, and Bhīṣma, and Jayadratha, and Karṇa , and likewise other valiant warriors also, whom I have killed, do you kill. Be not alarmed. Do fight. And in the battle you will conquer your foes.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
सञ्जय उवाच।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥
iast:
sañjaya uvāca
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya kṛtāñjalirvepamānaḥ kirīṭī
namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
english_telang: Hearing these words of Kesava, the wearer of the coronet, trembling, and with joined hands, bowed down and sorely afraid, and with throat choked up, he again spoke to Kṛṣṇa after saluting him.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ
english_telang: It is quite proper O Hṛṣīkeśa! that the universe is delighted and charmed by your renown that the demons run away affrighted in all directions

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ॥
iast:
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman garīyase brahmaṇo.apyādikartre
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
english_telang: and that all the assemblages of Siddhas bow down,(to you). And why O high-souled one! should they not bow down to you (who are) greater than Brahman and first cause? O infinite lord of gods! O you pervading the universe! you are the indestructible, that which is, that which is not, and what is beyond them.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्-
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप ॥
iast:
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇasa- tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
english_telang: You are the primal god, the ancient being, you are the highest support of this universe. You are that which has knowledge, that which is the object of knowledge, you are the highest goal. By you is this universe pervaded., O you of infinite forms!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते ॥
iast:
vāyuryamo.agnirvaruṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ prajāpatistvaṃ prapitāmahaśca
namo namaste.astu sahasrakṛtvaḥ punaśca bhūyo.api namo namaste
english_telang: You are the wind, Yama , fire, Varuṇa, the moon, you Prajāpati, and the great grandsire. Obeisance be to thee a thousand times, and again and again obeisance to thee! In front and from behind obeisance to thee!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः ॥
iast:
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste namo.astu te sarvata eva sarva
anantavīryāmitavikramastvaṃ sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato.asi sarvaḥ
english_telang: Obeisance be to thee from all sides, O you who are all! You are of infinite power, of unmeasured glory you pervade all, and therefore you are all!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥
iast:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi
english_telang: Whatever I have said contemptuously,—for instance, 'O Kṛṣṇa!' 'O Yādava !' 'O friend!'—thinking you to be (my) friend, and not knowing your greatness (as shown in) this (universal form), or through friendliness, or incautiously

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् ॥
iast:
yaccāvahāsārthamasatkṛto.asi vihāraśayyāsanabhojaneṣu
eko.athavāpyacyuta tatsamakṣaṃ tatkṣāmaye tvāmahamaprameyam
english_telang: and whatever disrespect I have shown you for purposes of merriment on (occasions of) play sleep dinner or sitting (together) whether alone or in the presence (of friends),—for all that O undegraded one! I ask pardon of you who are indefinable.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव ॥
iast:
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān
na tvatsamo.astyabhyadhikaḥ kuto.anyo lokatraye.apyapratimaprabhāva
english_telang: You are the father of the world-movable and immovable,—you its great and venerable master there is none equal to you, whence can there be one greater, O you whose power is unparalleled in all the three worlds?

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ॥
iast:
tasmātpraṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ prasādaye tvāmahamīśamīḍyam
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
english_telang: Therefore I bow and prostrate myself, and would propitiate you, the praiseworthy lord. Be pleased, O god! to pardon (my guilt) as a father (that of his) son, a friend (that of his) friend, or a husband (that of his) beloved.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
iast:
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito.asmi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
english_telang: I am delighted at seeing what I had never seen before, and my heart is also alarmed by fear. Show me that same form, O god! Be gracious, O lord of gods! O you pervading the universe!

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तं
इच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ॥
iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahastaṃ icchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
english_telang: I wish to see you bearing the coronet and the mace, with the discus in hand, just the same (as before). O you of thousand arms! O you of all forms! assume that same four-handed form.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
english_telang: O Arjuna ! being pleased (with you) I have by my own mystic power shown you this supreme form full of glory universal infinite primeval

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर्-
न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ॥
iast:
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānaira- na ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
english_telang: and which has not been seen before by any one else but you O you hero among the Kauravas! I cannot be seen in this form by any one but you, (even) by (the help of) the study of the Vedas or of sacrifices nor by gifts nor by actions nor by fierce penances.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥
iast:
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
english_telang: Be not alarmed, be not perplexed, at seeing this form of mine, fearful like this. Free from fear and with delighted heart, see now again that same form of mine.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
सञ्जय उवाच।
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥
iast:
sañjaya uvāca
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
english_telang: Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Vāsudeva again showed his own form, and the high-souled one becoming again of a mild form, comforted him who had been affrighted.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana
idānīmasmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
english_telang: O Janardana ! seeing this mild, human form of yours, I am new in my right mind, and have come to my normal state. Even the gods are always desiring to see this form of mine, which it is difficult to get a sight of, and which you have seen. I cannot be seen

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama
devā apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
english_telang: as you have seen me by (means of) the Vedas not by penance

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥
iast:
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
english_telang: not by gift

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥
iast:
bhaktyā tvananyayā śakya ahamevaṃvidho.arjuna
jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa
english_telang: nor yet by sacrifice. But O Arjuna! by devotion to me exclusively I can in this form be truly known seen

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
iast:
matkarmakṛnmatparamo madbhaktaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
english_telang: and assimilated with O terror of your foes! He who performs acts for (propitiating) me to whom I am the highest (object) who is my devotee who is free from attachment and who has no enmity towards any being he O son of Pāṇḍu! comes to me.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsate
ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ
english_telang: Of the worshippers, who thus, constantly devoted, meditate on you, and those who (meditate) on the unperceived and indestructible, which best know devotion? Those who being constantly devoted and possessed of the highest faith

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।
श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate
śraddhayā parayopetāḥ te me yuktatamā matāḥ
english_telang: worship me with a mind fixed on me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।
सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलन्ध्रुवम् ॥
iast:
ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ paryupāsate
sarvatragamacintyañca kūṭasthamacalandhruvam
english_telang: are deemed by me to be the most devoted. But those who restraining the (whole) group of the senses

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
iast:
sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ
te prāpnuvanti māmeva sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
english_telang: and with a mind at all times equable meditate on the indescribable indestructible unperceived (principle) which is all-pervading unthinkable indifferent

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ॥
iast:
kleśo.adhikatarasteṣāmavyaktāsaktacetasām
avyaktā hi gatirduḥkhaṃ dehavadbhiravāpyate
english_telang: immovable and constant they intent on the good of all beings necessarily attain to me. For those whose minds are attached to the unperceived the trouble is much greater. Because the unperceived goal is obtained by embodied (beings) with difficulty. As to those however O son of Pṛthā! who dedicating all their actions to me and (holding) me as their highest (goal)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥
iast:
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ
ananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate
english_telang: worship me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥
iast:
teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt
bhavāmi nacirātpārtha mayyāveśitacetasām
english_telang: meditating on me with a devotion towards none besides me and whose minds are fixed on me I Without delay come forward as their deliverer from the ocean of this world of death.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥
iast:
mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
english_telang: Place your mind on me only

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय ॥
iast:
atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram
abhyāsayogena tato māmicchāptuṃ dhanañjaya
english_telang: fix your understanding on me. In me you will dwell hereafter, (there is) no doubt. But if you are unable to fix your mind steadily on me then

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ॥
iast:
abhyāse.apyasamartho.asi matkarmaparamo bhava
madarthamapi karmāṇi kurvansiddhimavāpsyasi
english_telang: O Dhanañjaya ! endeavour to obtain me by the abstraction of mind (resulting) from continuous meditation. If you are unequal even to continuous meditation, then let acts for (propitiating) me be your highest (aim). Even performing actions for (propitiating) me, you will attain perfection.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥
iast:
athaitadapyaśakto.asi kartuṃ madyogamāśritaḥ
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
english_telang: If you are unable to do even this

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ॥
iast:
śreyo hi jñānamabhyāsājjñānāddhyānaṃ viśiṣyate
dhyānātkarmaphalatyāgastyāgācchāntiranantaram
english_telang: then resort to devotion to me and with self-restraint abandon all fruit of action. For knowledge is better than continuous meditation concentration is esteemed higher than knowledge and the abandonment of fruit of action than concentration from (that) abandonment tranquillity soon (results). That devotee of mine

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
iast:
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca
nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
english_telang: who hates no being who is friendly and compassionate who is free from egoism and from (the idea that this or that is) mine to whom happiness and misery are alike who is forgiving

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
iast:
santuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_telang: contented constantly devoted self-restrained and firm in his determinations and whose mind and understanding are devoted to me he is dear to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥
iast:
yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ
harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
english_telang: He through whom the world is not agitated and who is not agitated by the world who is free from joy and anger and fear and agitation he too is dear to me. That devotee of mine

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
iast:
anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_telang: who is unconcerned pure assiduous impartial free from distress who abandons all actions (for fruit) he is dear to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः ॥
iast:
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati
śubhāśubhaparityāgī bhaktimānyaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_telang: He who is full of devotion to me

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥
iast:
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
english_telang: who feels no joy and no aversion who does not grieve and does not desire who abandons (both what is) agreeable and (what is) disagreeable he is dear to me. He who is alike to friend and foe as also in honour and dishonour

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित्।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥
iast:
tulyanindāstutirmaunī santuṣṭo yena kenacit
aniketaḥ sthiramatirbhaktimānme priyo naraḥ
english_telang: who is alike in cold and heat pleasure and pain who is free from attachments to whom praise and blame are alike who is taciturn and contented with anything whatever (that comes) who is homeless and of a steady mind and full of devotion that man is dear to me. But those devotees who

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥
iast:
ye tu dharmyāmṛtamidaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsate
śraddadhānā matparamā bhaktāste.atīva me priyāḥ
english_telang: imbued with faith and (regarding) me as their highest (goal) resort to this holy (means for attaining) immortality as stated they are extremely dear to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetramityabhidhīyate
etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
english_telang: O son of Kuntī ! is called Kṣetra

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥
iast:
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama
english_telang: and the learned call him who knows it the Kṣetrajña.. And know me also O descendant of Bharata! to be the Kṣetrajña in all Kṣetras . The knowledge of Kṣetra and Kṣetrajña is deemed by me (to be real) knowledge. Now hear from me in brief what that Kṣetra (is)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥
iast:
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛkca yadvikāri yataśca yat
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
english_telang: what (it is) like what changes (it undergoes) and whence (it comes) and what is he

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥
iast:
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthak
brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniścitaiḥ
english_telang: and what his powers, (all which) is sung in various ways by sages in numerous hymns distinctly and in well-settled texts full of argument giving indications or full instruction about the Brahman . The great elements

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥
iast:
mahābhūtānyahaṃkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
english_telang: egoism the understanding the unperceived also the ten senses and the one and the five objects of sense

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ
etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtam
english_telang: desire aversion pleasure pain body

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥
iast:
amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
english_telang: consciousness courage thus in brief has been declared the Kṣetra with changes.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहंकार एव च।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥
iast:
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṃkāra eva ca
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam
english_telang: Absence of vanity, absence of ostentatiousness, absence of hurtfulness, forgiveness, straightforwardness, devotion to a preceptor, purity, steadiness, self-restraint, indifference towards objects of sense, and also absence of egoism perception of the misery and evil of birth, death, old age, and disease

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥
iast:
asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
english_telang: absence of attachment, absence of self-identifying regard for son, wife, home, and so forth and constant equability on the approach of (both what is) agreeable and (what is) disagreeable

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥
iast:
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
english_telang: unswerving devotion to me, without meditation on any one else resorting to clean places distaste for assemblages of men

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥
iast:
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato.anyathā
english_telang: constancy in knowledge of the relation of the individual self to the supreme perception of the object of knowledge of the truth this is called knowledge that is ignorance which is opposed to this.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥
iast:
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute
anādi matparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate
english_telang: I will declare that which is the object of knowledge, knowing which, one reaches immortality the highest Brahman, having no beginning nor end, which cannot be said to be existent or non-existent.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
iast:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato.akṣiśiromukham
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
english_telang: It has hands and feet on all sides it has eyes heads

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥
iast:
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
english_telang: and faces on all sides it has ears on all sides it stands pervading everything in the world. Possessed of the qualities of all the senses, (but) devoid of all senses, unattached, it supports all, is devoid of qualities, and the enjoyer of qualities.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥
iast:
bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva ca
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat
english_telang: It is within all things and without them it is movable and also immovable it is unknowable through (its) subtlety it stands afar and near.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
iast:
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
english_telang: Not different in (different) things, but standing as though different, it should be known to be the supporter of (all) things, and that which absorbs and creates (them). It is the radiance even of the radiant (bodies)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥
iast:
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
english_telang: it is said (to be) beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the object of knowledge, that which is to be attained to by knowledge, and placed in the heart of all.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥
iast:
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ
madbhakta etadvijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate
english_telang: Thus in brief have Kṣetra, knowledge, and the object of knowledge been declared. My devotee, knowing this, becomes fit for assimilation with me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् ॥
iast:
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādi ubhāvapi
vikārāṃśca guṇāṃścaiva viddhi prakṛtisambhavān
english_telang: Know nature and spirit both (to be) without beginning, and know all developments and qualities (to be) produced from nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥
iast:
kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtirucyate
puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve heturucyate
english_telang: Nature is said to be the origin of the capacity of working (residing) in the body and the senses and spirit is said (to be) the origin of the capacity of enjoying pleasures and pains. For spirit with nature joined

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥
iast:
puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijānguṇān
kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo.asya sadasadyonijanmasu
english_telang: enjoys the qualities born of nature. And the cause of its birth in good or evil wombs is the connexion with the qualities.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥
iast:
upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ
paramātmeti cāpyukto dehe.asminpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
english_telang: The supreme spirit in this body is called supervisor, adviser, supporter, enjoyer, the great lord, and the supreme self also.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥
iast:
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha
sarvathā vartamāno.api na sa bhūyo.abhijāyate
english_telang: He who thus knows nature and spirit, together with the qualities, is not born again, however living.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ॥
iast:
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā
anye sāṅkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
english_telang: Some by concentration see the self in the self by the self others by the Sāṅkya- yoga and others still by the Karma-yoga

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥
iast:
anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate
te.api cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
english_telang: others yet, not knowing this, practise concentration, after hearing from others. They, too, being (thus) devoted to hearing (instruction) cross beyond death.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
yāvatsañjāyate kiñcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha
english_telang: Whatever thing movable or immovable comes into existence, know that to be from the connexion of Kṣetra and Kṣetrajña, O chief of the descendants of Bharata!

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
iast:
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram
vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
english_telang: He sees (truly) who sees the supreme lord abiding alike in all entities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
samaṃ paśyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim
english_telang: and not destroyed though they are destroyed. For he who sees the lord abiding everywhere alike does not destroy himselfby himself and then reaches the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥
iast:
prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ
yaḥ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati
english_telang: He sees (truly) who sees (all) actions (to be) in every way done by nature alone and likewise the self (to be) not the doer. When a man sees all the variety of entities as existing in one and (all as) emanating from that

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥
iast:
yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyati
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā
english_telang: then he becomes (one with) the Brahman.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥
iast:
anāditvānnirguṇatvātparamātmāyamavyayaḥ
śarīrastho.api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
english_telang: This inexhaustible supreme self being without beginning and without qualities does not act

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥
iast:
yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyādākāśaṃ nopalipyate
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
english_telang: and is not tainted

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥
iast:
yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥ
kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
english_telang: O son of Kuntī! though stationed in the body. As by (reason of its) subtlety the all-pervading space is not tainted so the self stationed in every body is not tainted. As the sun singly lights up all this world

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥
iast:
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
english_telang: so the Kṣetrajña O descendant of Bharata! lights up the whole Kṣetra. Those who, with the eye of knowledge, thus understand the difference between Kṣetra and Kṣetrajña, and the destruction of the nature of all entities, go to the supreme.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam
yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
english_telang: Again I will declare (to you) the highest knowledge the best of (all sorts of) knowledge

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
iast:
idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ
sarge.api nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
english_telang: having learnt which all sages have reached perfection beyond (the bonds of) this (body). Those who, resorting to this knowledge, reach assimilation with my essence, are not born at the creation, and are not afflicted at the destruction (of the universe).

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।
सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥
iast:
mama yonirmahad brahma tasmingarbhaṃ dadhāmyaham
sambhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
english_telang: The great Brahman is a womb for me in which I cast the seed. From that O descendant of Bharata! is the birth of all things. Of the bodies O son of Kuntī ! which are born from all wombs the (main) womb is the great Brahman

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥
iast:
sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
english_telang: and I (am) the father

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam
english_telang: the giver of the seed. Goodness passion darkness these qualities born from nature O you of mighty arms! bind down the inexhaustible soul in the body. Of these

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥
iast:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
english_telang: goodness which in consequence of being untainted is enlightening and free from (all) misery binds the soul O sinless one! with the bond of pleasure and the bond of knowledge.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥
iast:
rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam
tannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
english_telang: Know that passion consists in being enamoured and is produced from craving and attachment. That O son of Kuntī! binds down the embodied (self) with the bond of action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥
iast:
tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām
pramādālasyanidrābhistannibadhnāti bhārata
english_telang: Darkness (you must) know to be born of ignorance it deludes all embodied (selfs). And that O descendant of Bharata! binds down (the self) with heedlessness indolence and sleep.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥
iast:
sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta
english_telang: Goodness unites (the self) with pleasure passion, O descendant of Bharata! with action and darkness with heedlessness, after shrouding up knowledge.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥
iast:
rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
english_telang: Passion and darkness being repressed, goodness stands, O descendant of Bharata! Passion and goodness (being repressed), darkness and likewise darkness and goodness (being repressed) passion. When in this body at all portals light (that is to say) knowledge prevails then should one know goodness to be developed. Avarice, activity, performance of actions, want of tranquillity, desire, these are produced, O chief of the descendants of Bharata! when passion is developed.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ॥
iast:
sarvadvāreṣu dehe.asminprakāśa upajāyate
jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
english_telang: Want of light

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhā
rajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
english_telang: want of activity

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥
iast:
aprakāśo.apravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
english_telang: heedlessness and delusion

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥
iast:
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
tadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
english_telang: these are produced O descendant of Kuru ! when darkness is developed. When an embodied (self) encounters death while goodness is developed then he reaches the untainted worlds of those who know the highest.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥
iast:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
english_telang: Encountering death during (the prevalence of) passion, he is born among those attached to action. Likewise, dying during (the prevalence of) darkness, he is born in the wombs of the ignorant.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥
iast:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam
rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
english_telang: The fruit of meritorious action is said to be good, untainted

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥
iast:
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato.ajñānameva ca
english_telang: while the fruit of passion is misery and the fruit of darkness ignorance. From goodness is produced knowledge, from passion avarice, and from darkness heedlessness and delusion and ignorance also.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥
iast:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
english_telang: Those who adhere to (the ways of) goodness go up the passionate remain in the middle while those of the qualities of darkness adhering to the ways of the lowest quality

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati
guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so.adhigacchati
english_telang: go down. When a right-seeing person sees none but the qualities (to be) the doers (of all action) and knows what is above the qualities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
iast:
guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto.amṛtamaśnute
english_telang: he enters into my essence. The embodied (self), who transcends these three qualities, from which bodies are produced, attains immortality, being freed from birth and death and old age and misery.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabho
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
english_telang: What are the characteristics, O lord! of one who has transcended these three qualities? What is his conduct, and how does he transcend these three qualities? He is said to have transcended the qualities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
english_telang: O son of Pāndu! who is not averse to light and activity and delusion (when they) prevail and who does not desire (them when they) cease

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥
iast:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate
guṇā vartanta ityevaṃ yo.avatiṣṭhati neṅgate
english_telang: who sitting like one unconcerned is never perturbed by the qualities who remains steady and moves not, (thinking) merely that the qualities exist who is self-contained

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥
iast:
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
tulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
english_telang: to whom pain and pleasure are alike to whom a sod and a stone and gold are alike to whom what is agreeable and what is disagreeable are alike who has discernment to whom censure and praise of himself are alike

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥
iast:
mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
english_telang: who is alike in honour and dishonour who is alike towards the sides of friends and foes and who abandons all action. And he who worships me with an unswerving devotion transcends these qualities

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
iast:
māṃ ca yo.avyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate
sa guṇānsamatītyaitānbrahmabhūyāya kalpate
english_telang: and becomes fit for (entrance into) the essence of the Brahman. For I am the embodiment of the Brahman

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥
iast:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāhamamṛtasyāvyayasya ca
śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
english_telang: of indefeasible immortality of eternal piety and of unbroken happiness.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
english_telang: They say the inexhaustible Aśvattha has (its) roots above, (its) branches below the Chandas are its leaves. He who knows it knows the Vedas .

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा
गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।
अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि
कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ॥
iast:
adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ
adhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
english_telang: Upwards and downwards extend its branches which are enlarged by the qualities and the sprouts of which are sensuous objects. And downwards to this human world are continued its roots which lead on to action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते
नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा।
अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलं
असङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ॥
iast:
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca sampratiṣṭhā
aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūlaṃ asaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
english_telang: Its form is not thus known here nor (its) end nor beginning nor support. But having with the firm weapon of unconcern cut this Aśvattha whose roots are firmly fixed

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं
यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।
तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये।
यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ॥
iast:
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
english_telang: then should one seek for that seat from which those that go there never return, (thinking) that one rests on that same primal being from whom the ancient course (of worldly life) emanated.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा
अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-
गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् ॥
iast:
nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ
dvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñaira- gacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat
english_telang: Those who are free from pride and delusion who have overcome the evils of attachment who are constant in (contemplating) the relation of the supreme and individual self from whom desire has departed who are free from the pairs (of opposites) called pleasure and pain go undeluded to that imperishable seat.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
iast:
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
english_telang: The sun does not light it, nor the moon, nor fire. That is my highest abode, going to which none returns.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥
iast:
mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati
english_telang: An eternal portion of me it is, which, becoming an individual soul in the mortal world, draws (to itself) the senses with the mind as the sixth.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।
गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात् ॥
iast:
śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ
gṛhitvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt
english_telang: Whenever the ruler (of the bodily frame) obtains or quits a body he goes taking these (with him) as the wind (takes) perfumes from (their) seats. And presiding over the senses of hearing and seeing and touch

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते ॥
iast:
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca
adhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate
english_telang: and taste and smell and the mind he enjoys sensuous objects.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ॥
iast:
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
english_telang: Those who are deluded do not see (him) remaining in or quitting (a body), enjoying or joined to the qualities they see, who have eyes of knowledge.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ॥
iast:
yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitam
yatanto.apyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ
english_telang: Devotees making efforts perceive him abiding within their selfs. But those whose selfs have not been refined and who have no discernment do not perceive him even (after) making efforts.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ॥
iast:
yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate.akhilam
yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam
english_telang: Know that glory (to be) mine which, dwelling in the sun, lights up the whole world, or in the moon or fire.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।
पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥
iast:
gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasā
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
english_telang: Entering the earth, I by my power support all things and becoming the juicy moon, I nourish all herbs.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
iast:
ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥ
prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham
english_telang: I becoming the fire

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो
मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो
वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् ॥
iast:
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanañca
vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham
english_telang: and dwelling in the bodies of (all) creatures and united with the upward and downward life-breaths cause digestion of the fourfold food. And I am placed in the heart of all from me (come) memory, knowledge, and their removal I alone am to be learnt from all the Vedas I am the author of the Vedāntas

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते ॥
iast:
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho.akṣara ucyate
english_telang: and I alone know the Vedas. There are these two beings in the world, the destructible and the indestructible. The destructible (includes) all things. The unconcerned one is (what is) called the indestructible. But the being supreme is yet another

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युधाहृतः।
यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः ॥
iast:
uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudhāhṛtaḥ
yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ
english_telang: called the highest self who as the inexhaustible lord pervading the three worlds

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
iast:
yasmātkṣaramatīto.ahamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ
ato.asmi loke vedeca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
english_telang: supports (them). And since I transcend the destructible and since I am higher also than the indestructible therefore am I celebrated in the world and in the Vedas as the best of beings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ॥
iast:
yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam
sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
english_telang: He who, undeluded, thus knows me the best of beings, worships me every way, O descendant of Bharata! knowing everything.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ।
एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ॥
iast:
iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha
etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata
english_telang: Thus, O sinless one! have I proclaimed this most mysterious science. He who knows this, has done all he need do, and he becomes possessed of discernment.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhirjñānayogavyavasthitiḥ
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
english_telang: Freedom from fear purity of heart perseverance in (pursuit of) knowledge and abstraction of mind gifts self-restraint and sacrifice

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥
iast:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam
dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam
english_telang: study of the Vedas penance straightforwardness harmlessness truth freedom from anger

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
iast:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā
bhavanti sampadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata
english_telang: renunciation tranquillity freedom from the habit of backbiting compassion for (all) beings freedom from avarice gentleness

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम् ॥
iast:
dambho darpo.abhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca
ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm
english_telang: modesty absence of vain activity noblemindedness forgiveness courage purity

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।
मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ॥
iast:
daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto.asi pāṇḍava
english_telang: freedom from a desire to injure others absence of vanity, (these) O descendant of Bharata! are his who is born to godlike endowments. Ostentatiousness, pride, vanity, anger, and also harshness and ignorance (are) his, O son of Pṛthā! who is born to demoniac endowments. Godlike endowments are deemed to be (means) for final emancipation, demoniac for bondage. Grieve not, O descendant of Bharata! you are born to godlike endowments.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
iast:
dvau bhūtasargau loke.asmindaiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
english_telang: (There are) two classes of created beings in this world, the godlike and the demoniac the godlike (class) has been described at length now hear from me, O son of Pṛthā! about the demoniac.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
iast:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
english_telang: Demoniac persons know not action or inaction, neither purity nor yet (correct) conduct nor veracity are in them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।
अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ॥
iast:
asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram
aparasparasambhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam
english_telang: They say the universe is devoid of truth devoid of fixed principle and devoid of a ruler produced by union (of male and female) caused by lust and nothing else.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥
iast:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno.alpabuddhayaḥ
prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato.ahitāḥ
english_telang: Holding this view, (these) enemies of the world, of ruined selfs, of little knowledge, and of ferocious actions, are born for the destruction (of the world).

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।
मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः ॥
iast:
kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ
mohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante.aśucivratāḥ
english_telang: Entertaining insatiable desire, full of vanity, ostentatiousness, and frenzy, they adopt false notions through delusion, and engage in unholy observances.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ॥
iast:
cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ
kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niścitāḥ
english_telang: Indulging in boundless thoughts ending with death given up to the enjoyment of objects of desire being resolved that that is all bound down by nets of hopes in hundreds

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ॥
iast:
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān
english_telang: given up to anger and desire they wish to obtain heaps of wealth unfairly for enjoying objects of desire.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ॥
iast:
idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham
idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam
english_telang: 'This have I obtained to-day this wish I will obtain this wealth is mine and this also shall be mine

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी ॥
iast:
asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi
īśvaro.ahamahaṃ bhogī siddho.ahaṃ balavānsukhī
english_telang: this foe I have killed others too I will destroy I am lord, I am the enjoyer, I am perfect, strong, happy I have wealth I am of noble birth

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥
iast:
āḍhyo.abhijanavānasmi ko.anyo.asti sadṛśo mayā
yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ
english_telang: who else is like me? I will sacrifice I will make gifts I will rejoice.' Thus deluded by ignorance

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ॥
iast:
anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake.aśucau
english_telang: tossed about by numerous thoughts surrounded by the net of delusion and attached to the enjoyment of objects of desire they fall down into impure hell. Honoured (only) by themselves void of humility

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
iast:
ātmasambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ
yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
english_telang: and full of the pride and frenzy of wealth these calumniators (of the virtuous) perform sacrifices which are sacrifices only in name

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः ॥
iast:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto.abhyasūyakāḥ
english_telang: with ostentatiousness and against prescribed rules indulging (their) vanity, brute force, arrogance, lust, and anger and hating me in their own bodies and in those of others.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रुरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥
iast:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krurānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu
english_telang: These enemies, ferocious, meanest of men, and unholy, I continually hurl down, to these worlds, only into demoniac wombs.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।
मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim
english_telang: Coming into demoniac wombs, deluded in every birth, they go down to the vilest state, O son of Kuntī ! without ever coming to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
iast:
trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet
english_telang: Threefold is this way, to hell,-ruinous to the self,—lust, anger, and likewise avarice therefore one should abandon this triad.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।
आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥ
ācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim
english_telang: Released from these three ways to darkness, O son of Kuntī! a man works out his own welfare, and then proceeds to the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
english_telang: He who abandoning scripture ordinances, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
iast:
tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi
english_telang: Therefore in discriminating between w hat should be done and what should not be done your authority (must. be) scripture. And knowing what is declared by the ordinances of scripture you should perform action in this world.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अर्जुन उवाच।
ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः ॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ
teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ
english_telang: What is the state of those, O Kṛṣṇa ! who worship with faith, (but) abandoning scripture ordinances—goodness, passion, or darkness?

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु ॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
english_telang: Faith is of three kinds in embodied (beings), it is produced from dispositions. It is of the quality of goodness, of the quality of passion, and of the quality of darkness. Hear about it.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥
iast:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata
śraddhāmayo.ayaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
english_telang: The faith of all, O descendant of Bharata! is conformable to the heart. A being here is full of faith, and whatever is a man's faith, that is a man himself.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।
प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः ॥
iast:
yajante sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ
pretānbhūtagaṇāṃścānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
english_telang: Those of the quality of goodness worship the gods those of the quality of passion the Yakṣas and Rakṣases and the others, the people of the quality of darkness, worship departed (spirits) and the multitudes of Bhūtas .

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।
दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः ॥
iast:
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
dambhāhaṃkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ
english_telang: Know those to be of demoniac convictions, who practise fierce penance not ordained by scripture who are full of ostentatiousness and egoism, and of desire, attachment, and stubbornness

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।
मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान् ॥
iast:
karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥ
māṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tānviddhyāsuraniścayān
english_telang: who are without discernment and who torment the groups of organs in (their) bodies, and me also seated within (those) bodies.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।
यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु ॥
iast:
āhārastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ
yajñastapastathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śṛṇu
english_telang: The food also, which is liked by all, and likewise the sacrifice, the penance, and gifts, are of three kinds. Listen to the distinctions regarding them as follows.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।
रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः ॥
iast:
āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥ
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
english_telang: The kinds of food which increase life, energy, strength, health, comfort, and relish, which are savoury, oleaginous, full of nutrition, and agreeable, are liked by the good. The kinds of food which are bitter acid saltish too hot sharp

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।
आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः ॥
iast:
kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥ
āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
english_telang: rough and. burning and which cause pain. grief and disease are desired by the passionate. And the food which is cold

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ॥
iast:
yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
ucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
english_telang: tasteless

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अफलाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।
यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ॥
iast:
aphalāṅkṣibhiryajño vidhidṛṣṭo ya ijyate
yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
english_telang: stinking stale impure and even leavings are liked by the dark. That sacrifice is good which being prescribed in (scripture) ordinances is performed by persons not wishing for the fruit (of it) and after determining (in their) mind that the sacrifice must needs be performed. But when a sacrifice is performed O highest of the descendants of Bharata! with an expectation of fruit (from it)

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अभिसन्धाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
iast:
abhisandhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
english_telang: and for the purpose of ostentation know that sacrifice (to be) passionate.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।
श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते ॥
iast:
vidhihīnamasṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnamadakṣiṇam
śraddhāvirahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate
english_telang: They call that sacrifice dark which is against the ordinances (of scripture) in which no food is dealt out (to Brāhmaṇas, &c.) which is devoid of Mantras devoid of Dakṣiṇā presents and which is without faith.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।
ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते ॥
iast:
devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucamārjavam
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate
english_telang: Paying reverence to gods, Brāhmaṇas, preceptors, and men of knowledge purity, straightforwardness, life as Brahmacārin , and harmlessness, (this) is called the penance bodily.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
iast:
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat
svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate
english_telang: The speech which causes no sorrow, which is true, agreeable, and beneficial, and the study of the Vedas , (this) is called the penance vocal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मनः प्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।
भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते ॥
iast:
manaḥ prasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunamātmavinigrahaḥ
bhāvasaṃśuddhirityetattapo mānasamucyate
english_telang: Calmness of mind, mildness, taciturnity, self-restraint, and purity of heart, this is called the penance mental.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः।
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते ॥
iast:
śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapastattrividhaṃ naraiḥ
aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate
english_telang: This threefold penance, practised with perfect faith, by men who do not wish for the fruit, and who are possessed of devotion is called good. The penance which is done for respect

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ॥
iast:
satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat
kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam
english_telang: honour

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।
परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
mūḍhagrāheṇātmano yatpīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ
parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tattāmasamudāhṛtam
english_telang: and reverence and with ostentatiousness and which is uncertain and transient is here called passionate. And that penance is described as dark which is performed under a misguided conviction with pain to oneself

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
iast:
dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate.anupakāriṇe
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
english_telang: or for the destruction of another. That gift is said (to be) good which is given because it ought to be given to one who (can) do no service (in return) at a (proper) place and time an d to a (proper) person. But that gift which is given with much difficulty

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।
दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
iast:
yattu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
english_telang: for a return of services or even with an expectation of fruit is said to be passionate. And that gift is described as dark

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।
असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
adeśakāle yaddānamapātrebhyaśca dīyate
asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
english_telang: which is given to unfit persons at an unfit place and time without respect

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ॐतत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥
iast:
OMtatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ
brāhmaṇāstena vedāśca yajñāśca vihitāḥ purā
